The Attorney General appeared in this matter repeatedly and submitted lists of such Under Trial Prisoners according to which ii Dhaka Central Jail up to 2.2.2003 there were 11 such children up to the age of 12 years. 2' up to the age of 13/14 years, 105 up to the age of 15/16 years and 63 up to the age of 1 years. In other Jails of the country there wen 25 such prisoners up to the age of 12 years, 6' up to the age of 13/14 years, 144 up to the age of 15/16 years and 150 up to age of 17/1: years. It has further been mentioned that of 12.01.2003, 16 children with mother wen detained in Jhenaidah District Jail any shortage of winter clothes of the children wen marked by the non-official Jail visitors  01 4.1.2003 one child was found with mother ii Narail District Jail and on 6.1.2003 in Jessore Central Jail 3 children of the age of 6/7 year were found detained with mother.
